title: Network partition functions and the octahedron recurrence explicitly describe positive birational rowmotion on rectangles
author: Johnson, Joseph; Liu, Ricky Ini
work: Birational rowmotion and the octahedron recurrence
difficulty_reason: The author constructs a cylindrical weighted network, proves octahedron identities by nonintersecting-path gluing, and derives every rowmotion iterate by a coupled boundary/interior induction. Reflection reciprocity then closes the rectangular periodicity formula. This is the full explicit dynamical construction, not a quoted periodicity result.
source_scope_note: The selected problem is original Theorem3.4 as one composite: the exact positive birational-rowmotion network partition quotient, reflection reciprocity and rectangular period for R=[r]x[s], x>0 and y=phi^{-1}(x). Complete author Sections1--3 retain the cylindrical weighted network, nonintersecting-path gluing/octrahedron identities, transfer/toggle definitions and all interior/boundary induction/reflection proofs1514--1680. Later chain-shifting and birational-RSK/Greene applications are unselected. Every original network/array diagram and every caption/formula/proof paragraph is editable native TikZ/TeX, with no diagram/proof image assets. Original ytableau calls occur only in omitted Section5; no ytableau, ydiagram or ytableaushort call occurs in retained body. Original mathdots/todonotes also have zero active commands here; these genuinely unused imports are omitted, with no dot or tableau substitute. Original T1 text-encoding import is omitted for standalone fontspec TU compatibility; mathematical body bytes/formula tokens remain intact. Approved bounded rendering note: the four original transparent0.0/1.0 controls resolve through installed native PGF fill/stroke opacity, preserving source draw paths, state order and following visible edges/labels. Other arguments are rejected. All affected original/output diagrams are compared; original transparent import is archived and no generalized package replacement is supplied.
